pd_teacher_leadership_002.answer: yes. Roles: Department Chairs, Academy/Collaboration Facilitators, Team Leaders, Elementary Leaders, Special Ed Dept Heads, SAT Chairs, IC members. Selection: Elected by constituents or selected by staff consensus/nomination. Duties: manage dept resources, coordinate curriculum/schedules, facilitate meetings, liaison to admin/parents, implement data strategies, direct SAT activities. Time: 2-year term (1 year for Elementary). Compensation: Differentials ($1,500-$1,929 Dept Chairs; $3,520 Academy/Team Leaders; $8,085 Elementary Leaders; $2,000 or .1 FTE SAT Chair).
pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Teacher Leadership Positions are in place to support distributive leadership throughout the school and are intended to be held by multiple staff members.
